# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Every morning you wake up, a battle is already waiting. Not against flesh and blood, but against complacency, distraction, and the quiet pull to just coast through another day. Joshua stood at the edge of the Promised Land facing the same choice you face at dawn: shrink back or step forward. God didn't tell him to feel brave—He commanded him to *be* brave. Courage is not the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of it. And notice the anchor: "the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." You are not fighting alone. The strength you need isn't manufactured in your own willpower—it's drawn from the God who goes before you. So get up, men. Pray before you scroll. Commit the day to the One who commands your courage. A warrior doesn't wait to feel ready; he rises because he's been commanded to. The battle belongs to the Lord, but the stepping forward belongs to you.
## Daily Challenge
Before your feet hit the floor, do 20 pushups and pray Joshua 1:9 out loud. Let every rep remind you that courage is a choice you make before the day makes it for you.
